name: Vibe Wizard Chess 3D
description:
Interactive 3D Gothic Cathedral Wizard Chess with sculpted stone pieces, cinematic melee captures, stone shatter physics, and single-player AI.Improve this existing app. Do NOT rebuild it from scratch and do NOT remove or simplify any current feature. Keep everything that works today: the 3D Gothic cathedral scene, sculpted stone pieces, cinematic melee captures, stone shatter physics, and the single-player AI. Every change below is an addition or a polish.

Goal: make it feel like "Chess Master" by Vibe Tech, a calm, honest chess app that is good for learning, playable on an Android phone.

1. Mobile first
- Works well in portrait on a phone (about 390x844) and still scales up to desktop.
- Large tap targets. Tap a piece, then tap a square (no dragging required).
- Keep a steady 60fps on a mid-range phone. Add a "Graphics: High / Low" setting where Low cuts particles, shadows and shatter debris but keeps the look.

2. Make the cinematics optional, not removed
- A setting: "Capture animations: Full / Quick / Off". Full is the current cinematic melee plus shatter. Quick is a short shatter only. Off is an instant capture.
- Tapping anywhere during a capture skips it.
- A camera reset button, plus a top-down 2D view toggle for thinking about moves.

3. AI opponent levels
- Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert, chosen before the game. Keep the existing AI engine and just tune its search depth or strength per level.
- Easy should make human-like mistakes so beginners can win.

4. Learning helpers (all can be switched off)
- Highlight legal moves for the selected piece.
- Show the last move, and show check clearly on the king.
- Undo move, and a hint button that suggests one good move.
- A move list in standard notation, plus the captured pieces for each side.

5. Lessons and Puzzle Coach screens
- A simple main menu: Play vs AI, Lessons, Puzzle Coach, Settings.
- Lessons: a few short starter lessons (how each piece moves, check vs checkmate, castling), each with a mini board to practise on.
- Puzzle Coach: a handful of mate-in-1 and mate-in-2 puzzles with a "Try again" and a "Show solution".
- Use the same cathedral art style throughout.

6. Full chess rules
- Castling, en passant, promotion (with a choice of piece), check, checkmate, stalemate, threefold repetition and the 50-move draw.
- A clear end-of-game screen with the result and a "Play again" button.

7. Feel and honesty
- Calm sound effects with a mute toggle. No flashing rewards, no timers pressuring the player, no ads, no fake purchase buttons, no login.
- Save the game in progress locally so closing the app doesn't lose it.

Before changing anything, list the features the app has now. When you're done, confirm every one of them still works and list exactly what you added.
